notes: Retrieved via the markdown mirror at https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/l40s.md (the .html path yields no extractable text). Prints dense|sparse pairs separated by 'I' with '*' marking the sparse column: 'TF32 Tensor Core TFLOPS 183 I 366*', 'BFLOAT16 362.05 I 733*', 'FP16 362.05 I 733*', 'FP8 733 I 1,466*', 'Peak INT8 733 I 1,466*', 'Peak INT4 733 I 1,466*'.
